name: Starcult. Night: Twisted Age
summary:
Starcult. Night: Twisted Age is a dark fantasy visual novel with romance and horror elements, set in a mysterious world on the brink of catastrophe.

Explore the life of Silviya, newly married into the noble House of Nebula. Silviya is an Artist, but in this world such skills reach far beyond pastels and paints. Hoping for a different life, she marries the young head of the House, Hans.

The story begins with the brutal murder of her husband by an unknown monster shortly after their wedding. Silviya calls for a detective to investigate the mysterious crime. But who is the real monster?

Use Silviya’s Emotion Palette to read the true feelings and intentions of friends and enemies, influence their actions, and try to escape countless death endings.

Shape your relationships and their nature, create your own cult, and make meaningful choices leading to multiple endings, including Detective, Hedonist, Mystic, Nihilist, Ascended, and hidden endings waiting to be discovered.
